name: Broadsword
description: A versatile double-edged blade with a sturdy crossguard, designed for both slashing sweeps and thrusts.

name: Shortbow
description: A compact yew recurve bow favored by scouts, skirmishers, and horse archers.

name: Dagger
description: A keen utility blade easily concealed beneath a traveler's cloak or sleeve.

name: Halberd
description: A polearm combining an axe blade and spear point mounted atop a long ash shaft.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A steel-limbed spanning crossbow that looses heavy bolts capable of piercing plate armor.

name: Greatsword
description: A massive two-handed sword with long quillons, capable of cleaving ranks of infantry.

name: Rapier
description: A slender, sharply pointed sword optimized for precision thrusting and elegant dueling.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A seasoned length of hardwood shod with iron caps, balancing reach and bludgeoning leverage.
